itinerary: Departure
We will pick you up at the rendezvous from 7.45 to 8.00 PM, and then we go to Ba Na Hills – “Sa Pa of the Central”, at an altitude of 1,487 m above the sea level.

You will be carried to the peak by the cable car system that won 4 World’s Records (longest one-wire sling; the longest distance between each station; the longest unpatched wire; and finally the heaviest cable roll), admire the epic view and enjoy the fresh air here.
Walking around or taking the funicular train to Linh Ung Pagoda, Debay wine cellar, Le Jardin D’Amour (the Flower Garden of Love) are also the good options for you after arriving Ba Na.

The next destination of your trip in Ba Na is The Fantasy Park – the world-class indoor amusement park. You can experience many thrilling rides and games such as water slide-way, love wheel, fire race and ghosts’ house. You can also buy the entrance ticket to visit the unique Wax
You will take a rest and have buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills

Besides, feel free to visit the holy places in Ba Na: the Linh Tu Temple, the Temple of Mother Nature, the Belfry, the Phong Tu Tower, or the French village. From this area, all the scenery of Ba Na – Quang Nam’s nature is below your feet.
We say good bye to Ba Na and get back to the cable car station and return to Danang
We will go back to your places in Da Nang. We hope this tour will bring you many unforgettable memories and joyful moments. See you again in other tours of Da Nang Local Tours !

tourName: Marble Mountain Hoi An Tour Good Price #1 - Da Nang Local Tours
itinerary: In the afternoon, we will pick you up at the rendezvous. We get the tour started and go to visit Marble Mountains . You will visit the Non Nuoc Village at the foot of Marble Mountain .
The village is famous for stone sculptures and handicrafts. Here you can admire many works of art made from stone and marble by the local artists.
If you want to challenge yourself physically, the Water Mount, one of the five mountains in the cluster, is a very good choice, with more than 150 steps for you to climb up.

Here you can visit many natural caves such as Huyen Khong cave , Tang Chon cave , and Hoa Nghiem cave . Besides, there are also religious places, including the first Linh Ung pagoda in Da Nang , T am Thai pagoda , and many other beautiful pagodas.
Saying good bye to Marble Mountains and the Non Nuoc village, we will go to Hoian ancient town .

Arriving Hoi An , one of the World’s Heritage Site, we will walk around this town, visit the ancient houses, ancient assembly hall, ancestral temple, and the symbol of Hoian, J apanese Bridge Pagoda . In Hoi An, everything is preserved as they were hundreds years ago.
At night time, Hoian shows its beauty with colorful lanterns hung all around the town, and in the night market, where you can buy various kinds of souvenirs.
We will introduce to you the specialties of Hoi An at dinner. After the meal, we will go back to your places in Da Nang
We hope this tour will bring you many unforgettable memories and joyful moments. See you again in other tours of Da Nang Local Tours !

itinerary: 08:00 AM – The Personal Welcome: Your professional guide and driver will be waiting at the Chan May Port gate with a personalized welcome sign. We start early to beat the massive tour groups arriving from the city.

08:15 AM – 09:45 AM: Relax in a comfortable, air-conditioned private vehicle. The drive takes you through local fishing villages and past the foothills of the famous Hai Van Pass. Your guide will share fascinating stories about the local culture and history along the way.

10:00 AM – The Ascent: Arrive at the foot of Ba Na Hills. Skip the long ticket lines (we pre-book for you) and board the cable car. Feel the temperature drop and the air freshen as you soar above the lush greenery.

10:30 AM – Walking on Clouds: Your first stop is the Golden Bridge. We aim to get here before the peak midday crowds so you can capture that "million-dollar photo." Afterward, visit the Linh Ung Pagoda and the Le Jardin D'Amour Flower Gardens.
Golden Bridge from Chan May Port

12:30 PM – A Gastronomic Feast: Head up to the second level via a short cable car ride to the French Village. Enjoy a high-quality International Buffet Lunch featuring over 100 dishes ranging from traditional Vietnamese flavors to Western favorites.

01:30 PM – Free Exploration & Fantasy: After lunch, you have free time to explore. Wander the French Village, watch the carnival performers, or visit the Lunar Castle. If you’re feeling adventurous, try the Alpine Coaster or the 4D/5D cinemas in the Fantasy Park.
02:45 PM – Final Descent: We gather for the direct cable car ride down. This 20-minute journey provides one last look at the breathtaking mountain scenery.
03:15 PM – Return Journey: Our driver will be waiting at the base for a smooth transfer back to the port.
04:45 PM – Back to Ship: Arrive at Chan May Port safely and on time, with plenty of time to relax on board before your ship departs.
